title: Ancient discovery from time of Jesus emerges near Jerusalem's Temple Mount
summary: Hebrew University archaeologists excavated a well-preserved ritual bathing complex, about 2,000 years old, in the Ophel just south of the Temple Mount. It likely served Jewish pilgrims purifying themselves before entering the Second Temple.

title: Massive 2,000-year-old discovery from time of Jesus emerges remarkably intact
summary: A Second Temple–period ritual bath (mikveh) weighing 25 tons was lifted intact by crane in Kiryat Gat, Israel, to protect it from construction, the Israel Antiquities Authority said.

title: Site where Jesus was crucified and buried reveals new evidence that backs biblical account
summary: Excavations beneath the Church of the Holy Sepulchre led by Francesca Stasolla found ancient seeds and pollen. The article says this is consistent with John 19:41's garden near the crucifixion site.
